name: prompt-translator
description: Translates the prompts you type into the language you choose and shows the translation right under each prompt

language.title: Translation language
language.description: The language your prompts are translated into. Prompts already written in it are not translated.

maxChars.title: Auto-translate limit
maxChars.description: Prompts longer than this many characters (spaces included) are translated only when they contain ultratranslate. Left empty, it is 300. 0 translates only prompts with the keyword.
